picks.headline: Google Cloud Open-Sources TorchTPU for Native PyTorch Execution on TPUs
picks.why: Engineers can now run native PyTorch workloads directly on Google Cloud TPUs without complex framework abstraction layers.
picks.title: TorchTPU is now open source: Run native PyTorch on TPUs

picks.headline: Google Releases llm-d 1.0 for Distributed Agent Inference on TPUs and GPUs
picks.why: Provides an open-source distributed serving runtime specifically designed for high-concurrency AI agent workloads across heterogeneous hardware.
picks.title: Announcing llm-d 1.0: Open distributed inference for agents on Google Cloud TPUs and GPUs

picks.headline: Kernel-Level Connection Escrow Holds AI Agent Egress Pending Isolated Verification
picks.why: Uses a 98-instruction eBPF program to intercept agent socket creation in the Linux kernel, preventing compromised containers from exfiltrating data.
picks.title: Connection Escrow: Holding AI-Agent Pod Egress in the Kernel Until an Isolated Verifier Rules

picks.headline: LLM Financial Trading Agents Vulnerable to 100% ASR Data Injection Attacks
picks.why: Demonstrates that fabricated news containing short template snippets can completely hijack autonomous market decisions by corrupting evidence context.
picks.title: Fake News, Real Crashes: Information Injection Attacks on LLM Financial Trading Agents

picks.headline: vLLM Adds Bi-Directional KV Cache Transfer for Multi-Turn Agent Workloads
picks.why: Significantly cuts time-to-first-token in agent interactions by allowing prefill nodes to fetch KV caches directly from decode nodes.
picks.title: Improve TTFT for multi-turn agentic workloads with bi-directional KV transfer in vLLM

picks.headline: OpenAI Focuses Evaluation Suite on Low-Resource Languages and COBOL Migration
picks.why: New benchmarks directly target automated legacy enterprise code migration and performance in non-mainstream programming languages.
picks.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages

papers.headline: Hybrid LLMs Suffer Competing Learning Between Recurrence and Attention Layers
papers.why: Explains why hybrid SSM-attention architectures stall during training, showing that fast linear-time recurrence layers suppress attention gradients.
papers.title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures

papers.headline: Variational Decoding Enables Up to 5.7x Faster Parallel Token Generation
papers.why: Bypasses standard autoregressive decoding by using latent auxiliary variables to generate multiple mutually consistent tokens in a single forward pass.
papers.title: Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding

papers.headline: Safety Mid-Training Internalizes Alignment Traces Before Post-Training Fine-Tuning
papers.why: Inserting a dedicated safety phase between pre-training and post-training prevents safety degradation while enhancing core reasoning capabilities.
papers.title: Safety Mid-Training: Internalizing LLM Safety as a Foundational Capability
